title: Configure valkey
description: Choose the role of the instance: standalone server, initial node of a new cluster, or member joining an existing cluster

role.description: standalone: one server, no cluster. initial: first node of a new Valkey Cluster, other instances can join it. join: become a member of the cluster cluster_id

cluster_id.description: With role join: ID of the cluster to join (from get-configuration cluster_candidates)

maxmemory_mb.description: Memory limit of each Valkey process in MiB, 0 for no limit. Writes fail when it is reached (noeviction)

allow_same_node.description: With role initial: let several members run on the same node. For tests only: such a cluster survives no node failure
